resumeIntent.observed: KlodaResumeBackupIntent.perform() ran and opened Kloda, but the WebDAV run stayed Duraklatıldı and no new requests reached the server.
resumeIntent.comparison: The in-app Devam et on the Durum page gives the same result (no requests, Yedekleme durdu).
resumeIntent.cause: Proven from the Simulator journal copy: latest webdav_run is automatic=0, phase waiting, error os_interrupted. IosWebDavQueue.status() reports a non-active manual waiting run as 'paused'; home-status/IosLiveActivityStatus then show Devam et, which calls resumeAutomatic / IosAutomaticCoordinator.resume(). That path only clears the automatic pause and replans automatic runs, so nothing ever restarts a manual run. Pre-existing in shared code, not caused by the Live Activity.

resumeFix.decision: User 2026-11-01: Resume on a paused manual run starts it again (same as Back up now).
resumeFix.change: home-page.tsx: when the automatic pause is off and the WebDAV run is a paused manual run, Resume calls transfer.run(); otherwise resumeAutomatic() as before. Never both. IosLiveActivityStatus: a paused manual WebDAV run (without the automatic pause) maps to 'waiting', so the lock screen offers only Open.
resumeFix.firstAttempt: Calling resumeAutomatic() and then run() was tried on the Simulator: the manual run restarted (new run 0f99a1f4, 14 GET 200 on the server, ended needs_attention/review_required because the photos already exist), but the automatic run started at the same time failed with backup_busy (new run 0bb96303, needs_attention). Hence the never-both rule. The race between IosWebDavAutomaticCoordinator.begin()'s available() check and IosWebDavQueue.start() is pre-existing shared native code (Codex is editing these files) and was not changed.

scriptedCapture.command: python3 -I tools/capture-ios-live-activity.py <simulator UDID> <output dir> (needs the apps/mobile/ios prebuild output)
scriptedCapture.how: Compiles the production KlodaLockCard views, copy, intents, attributes and the generated theme with packages/pairing-native/apple/tests/IosLiveActivityCapture.swift for the iOS Simulator, compiles the generated icon catalog with actool, and runs it with simctl spawn once per language (-AppleLanguages). ImageRenderer draws every phase (syncing with operations, syncing PC+WebDAV, paused, stale, waiting, safe, attention, error) per sheet. The card background stands in for activityBackgroundTint; the system lock screen chrome and Dynamic Island are not drawn.
scriptedCapture.result: PASS on Kloda-Cloud18-Disposable: 12 sheets (tr/en/de x dark, light, dark-xxxl, dark-ax2) in captures/.
findings: TR/EN/DE: every string present; nothing truncated at the default size or at xxxLarge (German is the longest).
Light appearance: the card stays on the dark tile token in both themes; only the Open button changes (brand-text). Matches the plugin's lockColors mapping.
Accessibility size AX2 (first run): button labels and long titles truncated ('Pausier…', 'Kloda ö…', 'Letzter Lauf abges…'); icons are fixed size.
Stale card: the title says Bekleniyor/Wartet while the Pause button stays (phase is still syncing). Not changed.

physicalRehearsal.purpose: Rehearse gate 21 items on the Simulator to reduce physical-test errors. Gate 21 stays open; nothing here counts as the physical PASS.
physicalRehearsal.setup: Simulator BGTaskScheduler submit always fails, so automatic_unavailable is present and (after the observe() fix) the card mirrors it as error and never opens. Rehearsal workaround: pause automatic backup in the app and relaunch, which clears the in-memory error, then start a manual run.
